```{r}
library(bayestestR)
### Mass

# 4-parameter model with GPSCs
Mass_4param_mcmc2 <- readRDS("/Users/llorenz/Documents/PhD_Project/Code/1st_project/WF_plots_postTAC2/2025_05_08/Mass_PPxSero2/PPxSero_ggCaller_PopPUNK_4param_det_pmcmc_run2.rds")
Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs <- coda::as.mcmc(cbind(Mass_4param_mcmc2$probabilities, Mass_4param_mcmc2$pars))
#coda::effectiveSize(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs)
#summary(coda::as.mcmc(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs))
Mass_likelihood_4param <- median(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs[,"log_likelihood"])
#mean(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs[,"log_likelihood"])
param_estimates <- map_estimate(Mass_4param_mcmc2$pars)
# -3.27, 0.24, -4.36, 0.08
# GPSCs:
# -3.24, 0.24, -4.31, 0.08
param_mean <- apply(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs, 2, mean)
percentile95_low <- apply(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs,2,quantile,.025)
percentile95_up <- apply(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs,2,quantile,.975)
#     log_prior log_likelihood  log_posterior        sigma_f         prop_f              m              v 
#    0.00000000  -216.93700171  -216.93700171    -3.46685002     0.34412010    -4.20067157     0.09226522 
#    0.00000000  -221.10809628  -221.10809628    -3.96755164     0.26854095    -4.70350782     0.07083447
#    0.0000000   -214.7636318   -214.7636318     -2.9528191      0.4381072     -3.6808380      0.1190635
rm(Mass_4param_mcmc2)
rm(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs)

param_mean_US <- param_mean
percentile95_low_US <- percentile95_low
percentile95_up_US <- percentile95_up


# stoch
Mass_4param_mcmc2_stoch <- readRDS("/Users/llorenz/Documents/PhD_Project/Code/1st_project/WF_plots_postTAC2/2025_07_23/US_stoch/PPxSero_ggCaller_PopPUNK4_stoch_pmcmc_run2.rds")
Mass_4param_mcmc2_stoch <- readRDS("/Users/llorenz/Documents/PhD_Project/Code/1st_project/WF_plots_postTAC2/2025_07_25/US_stoch/PPxSero_ggCaller_PopPUNK4_stoch_pmcmc_run2.rds")

percentile95_up <- apply(Mass_4param_mcmc2_probs,2,quantile,.975)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# plot results
joined_mcmc_param_fits <- data.frame(params = rep(c("NFDS strength", "genes under NFDS", "migration rate", "vaccination strength"), 3),
                                     population = c(rep("US",4), rep("UK",4), rep("Nepal",4)),
                                     mean = c(param_mean_US[4:7], param_mean_UK[4:7], param_mean_Nepal[4:7]),
                                     lower = c(percentile95_low_US[4:7], percentile95_low_UK[4:7], percentile95_low_Nepal[4:7]),
                                     upper = c(percentile95_up_US[4:7], percentile95_up_UK[4:7], percentile95_up_Nepal[4:7]))
joined_mcmc_param_fits[c(1,3,5,7,9,11),c("mean", "lower", "upper")] <- exp(joined_mcmc_param_fits[c(1,3,5,7,9,11),c("mean", "lower", "upper")])

ggplot(joined_mcmc_param_fits,aes(x=params,y=mean, colour = population, group = interaction(population, params))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper,color=population,width=0.2),position = position_dodge(width=0.75),, size = 1) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width=0.75),size = 3) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey"),text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  labs(y= "Parameter estimate", x = "Parameter")

ggplot(joined_mcmc_param_fits,aes(x=population,y=mean, colour = population, group = interaction(population, params))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower,ymax=upper,color=population,width=0.2), size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~params, ncol = 2) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey"),text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  labs(y= "Parameter estimate", x = "Population")
```

```{r}
# compare genes under NFDS
# US: 0.34412010
# UK: 0.2264006
# Nepal: 0.241534

Mass_delta_rank <- readRDS("ggC_delta_ranking.rds") # 2035 intermed-freq genes
UK_delta_rank <- readRDS("UK_delta_ranking.rds") # 2048 intermed-freq genes
Nepal_delta_rank <- readRDS("Nepal_delta_ranking.rds") # 2484 intermed-freq genes

# absolute number of genes under NFDS:
# US: 700
# UK: 464
# Nepal: 600

gene_overlap_USUKNepal <- intersect(intersect(names(Mass_delta_rank), names(UK_delta_rank)), names(Nepal_delta_rank))
# 1418 intermed-freq genes overlap btw all three

Mass_underNFDS <- rep(0, length(Mass_delta_rank))
names(Mass_underNFDS) <- names(Mass_delta_rank)
Mass_underNFDS[which(Mass_delta_rank <= 0.34412010 * length(Mass_delta_rank))] <- 1
UK_underNFDS <- rep(0, length(UK_delta_rank))
names(UK_underNFDS) <- names(UK_delta_rank)
UK_underNFDS[which(UK_delta_rank <= 0.2264006 * length(UK_delta_rank))] <- 1
Nepal_underNFDS <- rep(0, length(Nepal_delta_rank))
names(Nepal_underNFDS) <- names(Nepal_delta_rank)
Nepal_underNFDS[which(Nepal_delta_rank <= 0.241534 * length(Nepal_delta_rank))] <- 1

gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS <- rep(0, length(gene_overlap_USUKNepal))
names(gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS) <- gene_overlap_USUKNepal
gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS <- gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS + Mass_underNFDS[gene_overlap_USUKNepal]
gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS <- gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS + UK_underNFDS[gene_overlap_USUKNepal]
gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS <- gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS + Nepal_underNFDS[gene_overlap_USUKNepal]

names(gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS[which(gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS==3)])
# 18

UK_ggCaller_intermed_preVac[names(gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS[which(gene_overlap_USUKNepal_underNFDS==3)]),1]
# "group_8480"  "group_8014"  "group_3107"  "group_2288"  "group_6380"
```
